profile.campus: Nabiax Julian Camarillo campus, Madrid (3 modules: N1, N2, N3)
address: Calle Julian Camarillo 29, E.1, Planta 3, 28037 Madrid, Spain
profile.reading: This Nabiax facility, module N1, is 1 of 3 modules on the operator own Julian Camarillo campus at Calle Julian Camarillo 29, Madrid, Spain, near Madrid Barajas airport. The campus was inaugurated in phases between 1995 and 2011. All 3 modules are built to Tier III specifications with 2N group topology and N+1 chiller and CRAH cooling. The operator own page gives combined campus totals of 10,000 square meters, 10 MW of current IT power expandable to 15 MW, and 29 IT rooms, but does not break these figures down by individual module, so no module specific capacity or square footage is attributed to this record. The operator states the campus runs on 100 percent renewable energy and is 100 percent carrier neutral. Nabiax's own company page states the operator began in 2019 when Asterion Industrial Partners acquired 11 data centers from Telefonica for approximately 550 million euros, a valuation reported by industry publication Dgtl Infra at roughly 18.3 times EBITDA. In May 2021, per that same reporting, Telefonica contributed four additional data centers, two in Spain and two in Chile with a combined 9 megawatts of capacity, back to Nabiax in exchange for a 20 percent equity stake, with Asterion and co-investors retaining the remaining 80 percent. In November 2024, per Nabiax's own site and independent legal and trade press coverage, Aermont Capital acquired Nabiax from Asterion Industrial Partners and Telefonica. Nabiax's own about page states the Julian Camarillo address in Madrid, the same address as this row, also serves as the company's headquarters, and describes the company's current Spanish portfolio as 6 data centers organized into 5 centers across 2 campuses, with 26 megawatts of installed IT power across 22,000 square meters company wide, alongside other Spanish locations including Alcala de Henares and Terrassa tracked separately from this Madrid campus. Nabiax positions itself as the leading colocation company in Spain, emphasizing carrier neutral infrastructure, 100 percent renewable energy, and modular colocation solutions for enterprise and telecom customers.
